name: VoltCore
one_liner: Deterministic battery management firmware for high-voltage industrial EV packs.

hard_problems.title: Deterministic CAN-FD frame scheduling under fault bursts
hard_problems.description: Sixteen daisy-chained battery modules flood the CAN-FD bus during cell over-voltage events, causing priority inversion and missed 250us watchdog deadlines.

hard_problems.title: Zero-copy ADC DMA acquisition in 256KB SRAM
hard_problems.description: Sampling 16 cell channels at 100kHz via SPI ADC and DMA without dynamic heap allocation risks silent ring-buffer overruns when contactor state interrupts preempt.

hard_problems.title: Power-fail-safe NOR flash fault logging
hard_problems.description: Black-box diagnostics must persist cycle counters and thermal fault snapshots across unexpected brownouts without corrupting erase blocks or exceeding flash endurance.
